retained_b1.conclusion: The actual T1 OOB additions do not invalidate the persisted front/sector/location state. The full repair neither assigns nor otherwise changes those formations. Any-OOB-created is therefore not a genuine repair condition for this boundary.

t1.topology_changes: the two validated forming formation additions only

t2.conclusion: The sessionless helper mutates persisted gameplay state on a proven topology-clean boundary. Its invocation cannot be justified as invariant repair.

canon_systems_decision: The successful public runTurn.nextState remains the canonical settled boundary. Scenario baseline exhaustion/displacement may intentionally mutate other state afterward, but it does not invalidate front/sector/location truth.

The retained T1 B state proves that the actual forming OOB additions are valid without a full rebuild. Do not gate on OOB call occurrence, formation-count change alone, baseline activity, week number, or generic A-to-B inequality.

applyControlFlipProposals is the only current post-run caller that directly changes political controllers. A positive applied count is a source-proven invalidator of derived front/sector truth and is the exact supported reason to invoke the scenario repair.
No evidence supports moving repair into runTurn, changing the helper's mechanics, or changing native/desktop behavior.

steps: Initialize a deterministic per-week appliedScenarioControlFlips count to zero before the shouldApplyBreaches block.
Capture applyControlFlipProposals(state, proposalsFile).applied into that count when the block executes.
Invoke repairScenarioArtifactState exactly once only when appliedScenarioControlFlips > 0.

When the count is zero, do not displace, recompute fronts, reconcile sectors, or rebuild ratings after the successful public turn; weekly reports, saves, replay/checkpoint artifacts, and the observer consume the post-handler state directly.
Preserve repairScenarioArtifactState unchanged and exported for its explicit artifact/test use.
Preserve the dedicated final-save operational-edge projection, reconciliation session, and seal unchanged.
explicitly_excluded_conditions: any OOB call or any created formation
forbidden_scope: data, coefficient, threshold, schema, save-format, baseline, or acceptance-criterion changes

required_focused_tests_before_expensive_: Canonical one- and two-week boundary characterization: applied control flips zero, helper entries zero, observer/weekly save state equals the post-handler B state, rs_22nd remains at Varosluk, and no scenario-only threat_ratio sentinel is introduced.
T1 forming OOB additions remain present, friendly, unassigned/forming as authored, and the existing state/operation/friendly/sector validators remain green without helper repair.

Synthetic applied-control case: applyControlFlipProposals returns applied > 0, the scenario caller invokes repair exactly once with operational OSID edges, and final fronts/sectors pass focused validators.
Synthetic zero-proposal and zero-applied cases skip repair.
Existing direct repairScenarioArtifactState enemy-territory/artifact test remains green, proving explicit helper behavior is preserved.
Final-save projection/session/seal and canonical save-load checks remain green and distinct from the weekly caller gate.
TypeScript and affected scenario-harness/determinism tests pass.
remaining_acceptance_gates: Independent review of the implemented caller-only diff and focused evidence.

Because removing the weekly mutation changes the canonical calibration trajectory, run the already-authorized authoritative 188-week qualifier and evaluate every existing score, OSID-loss, anchor, provenance, graph, consistency, preservation, and artifact criterion without tuning or waiver.
Run the required full suite only after the authoritative candidate qualifies, reusing unaffected evidence where allowed.
